messages:
Alyssa: @Samir welcome aboard! Quick Day 1 note (Mon 9:30am PT): I-9 + ID, laptop pickup vs ship, and benefits intro at 10am PT. Can you do hardware in SF at 8:45am or need it shipped?
Samir: Thanks! I'm in Boston (ET) so can't make SF. Ship please. Also I'm waiting on an international police certificate for the bg check (est 3-5 biz days). Will that prevent Day 1?
Alyssa: Ship is fine. For I-9 if you can't do SF we can use an authorized representative (we have a short form) or a local notary. BG pending won't stop orientation — we'll limit PROD access until clear.
Jon: @Samir pls DM shipping address. Imaging + provisioning ~24-48h after we claim the asset. Confirm macOS or Linux image.
Samir: DM'd address. macOS preferred. Also curious: will VPN and internal trackers be available Day 1?
Alyssa: VPN for trainings/docs yes. Full Prod and some admin apps remain gated until ID + BG verification complete. We'll grant console demo access so you can follow along.
Maria: (bg vendor) We have one outstanding ref and the international cert. I've escalated the certificate request with partner; hoping for update in 2-4 business days. If you have any supporting docs (old residency letter, police clearance waiver) email bg@redwood.com to help speed it.
Samir: I'll send supporting docs now. Can I still enroll in benefits Day 1?
Alyssa: Yes — benefits walkthrough and elections are fine Day 1; activation depends on HR timelines but you can submit elections. Invite: Benefits 10:00am PT, Team intro 11:15am PT.
Alyssa: Day 1 micro-checklist:
```
- I-9: bring passport OR passport + driver's license OR complete authorized-rep/notary form
- BG: awaiting international police cert; email bg@redwood.com with any docs
- Laptop: shipped by IT (Jon) -> confirm address in DM; imaging takes 24-48h
- Calendar: Benefits 10:00am PT; Team intro 11:15am PT
- Access: Zoom and Console demo day-of; PROD gated until verifications
```
Jon: I'll build the shipping label once I have the address. Expect delivery ~2 business days and imaging to finish next day. I'll post tracking. :shipit:
people-ops-bot: Reminder set: Day 1 checklist will be delivered 1 day before start date.
Samir: Thanks everyone — really helpful. See you Monday! :thumbsup:
